questions.prompt: What is the capital city of Pakistan?

hints.nudge: A capital city is where a country’s government meets. The other three are capital cities too, of other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Pakistan article.

questions.proof: The capital of Pakistan is Islamabad, but before 1960, it was Karachi, which is now the country's largest city.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries shares a border with Pakistan?

hints.nudge: Two countries are neighbours when you can walk from one into the other. Picture Pakistan on the globe and look at what it touches.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Pakistan article.

questions.proof: It shares its border with other countries India, Iran, Afghanistan and China (disputed with India).

questions.prompt: Which language is an official language of Pakistan?

hints.nudge: An official language is the one used in schools, courts and government. The other three are spoken in other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the “Name” part of the Pakistan article.

questions.proof: The Islamic name Pakistan (English pronunciation: () or (); Urdu: پاکستان [paːkɪˈst̪aːn]) means 'Land of (the) Spiritually Pure' in both Urdu and Persian languages.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “Pakistan and _____ have held 12 rounds of discussions for deciding the exact sea frontier at Kori Creek and the un-demarcated Rann of Kachchh.”

hints.nudge: In the sentence the missing word sits beside “Pakistan”. It names one thing, not an action.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the “Maritime borders of Pakistan” part of the Pakistan article.

questions.proof: Pakistan and India have held 12 rounds of discussions for deciding the exact sea frontier at Kori Creek and the un-demarcated Rann of Kachchh.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “Using Unclos III, Pakistan has also demarcated its sea boundaries with both _____ and Oman.”

hints.nudge: In the sentence the missing word sits beside “Oman”. It names one thing, not an action.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the “Maritime borders of Pakistan” part of the Pakistan article.

questions.proof: Using Unclos III, Pakistan has also demarcated its sea boundaries with both Iran and Oman.
